title: AEGIS: Evidence-Guided Set Decisions for Requirement-to-Code Traceability
abstract: arXiv:2611.30093v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Requirement-to-code traceability recovery identifies code artifacts that implement a requirement, but manual review costs limit how many candidates developers can inspect. Code relations can reveal candidates missed by textual retrieval, yet can also introduce code unrelated to the requirement. We propose AEGIS, which combines retrieval evidence and code relations to construct and revise trace sets under a project-wide review budget. Grouped retrieval and semantic retrieval supply candidates. A set objective combines relevance to the requirement with structural compatibility. Local search constructs sets of different sizes, and dynamic programming selects one set per requirement within the budget. Call-context admission then compares replacements using evidence from arguments and return values in calls involving protected members, while bounding retrieval-score loss. translated_title: AEGIS：面向需求-代码可追溯性的证据引导集合决策
translated_abstract: 需求到代码的可追溯性恢复旨在识别实现某个需求的代码工件，但人工审查成本限制了开发者能够检查的候选数量。代码关系可以揭示文本检索遗漏的候选，但也可能引入与需求无关的代码。我们提出AEGIS，它在项目级审查预算下结合检索证据和代码关系来构建和修订可追溯集合。分组检索和语义检索提供候选。集合目标函数将需求相关性同结构兼容性相结合。局部搜索构建不同规模的集合，动态规划在预算内为每个需求选择一个集合。随后，调用上下文准入利用涉及受保护成员的调用中参数和返回值的证据来比较替换项，同时约束检索分数的损失。在13个项目上，AEGIS在……上取得了最高的项目宏平均（摘要原文在此处截断）。
tldr: 提出AEGIS框架，将检索证据与代码关系相结合，在项目级审查预算下通过局部搜索、动态规划和调用上下文准入机制，为需求构建并修订代码可追溯集合，从而在有限的审查成本下提升可追溯性恢复质量。
en_tdlr: AEGIS combines retrieval evidence and code relations to construct and revise requirement-to-code trace sets under a project-wide review budget, using local search, dynamic programming, and call-context admission to optimize set decisions.
